author: Shadowbladz
body:
Name: Shadowbladz

Ban reason: Excessive Disrespect/Vulgarity

Appeal: So, I won't give all the insanely far back details, but in essence, I was kicked. I did not agree with this kick at all, so when the mod who gave the kick came into TS I asked "Why?", he then continued to go on and on about "common sense" and how "i should know why I was kicked", eventually just leaving the room and returning to a staff room, where i couldn't talk to him.

Later on I was chatting with an ex-mod, him and I got around to talking about my kick, and after hearing what had happened he agreed the kick wasn't deserved, and started asking the mod to come in and explain it. Eventually I asked him to come in too. After some pestering the mod came into our TS, and started to explain why I was kicked.

Firstly, he gave the reason that I was making sexual innuendos in chat. I agreed, I was, BUT, I was warned for these jokes, and asked him "if I was already warned, could I be kicked for the exact same thing?" He said no, I could not. So then I again asked him, why I was kicked. He said I was kicked for vulgarity, I pointed out I only used one curse word (fucking) in the few sentences that got me kicked, I asked, "am I not allowed to curse in chat? When it's not even directed at someone?". He said yes, I am allowed to curse. So as you can see, at this point the mod could not give me a single reason for my kick, so I asked him again, why was I kicked. The mod then asked me "How old are you?" I asked him why he needed to know my age, and then I told him (15). He said that at this age I should have some common sense, and I should know why I was kicked. So once again, I asked him why I was kicked. At this point he adopted an exasperated tone, saying "I've told you already, I've told you already", when I asked him again, why I was kicked. He started laughing "I've told you already". Keep in mind this went on in a public TS room, infront of 4-5 people. So I asked Cyclops who was in the room with me "Has he given me a reason?", Cyclops told me no, he hadn't.

So as you can imagine, at this point I was getting annoyed, I was hounding the mod about the reason for my kick, and eventually cursed, or annoyed him. I don't know what I did exactly, but I got kicked from TS for disrespect. When I came back, the mod was gone, and refused to come out of the staff room and talk to me. So I gave up on it, decided a warn isn't bad, and just went back to playing the game.

After a while Cyclops told me AviGil wanted to talk to me about what happened. So I went in, explained the situation and he just told me to live with the warn, and forget about it. Fair enough.

So after a while I get a message on skype saying I was banned, I check and sure enough, banned. So basically the whole point of those story, is that I was never "disrespectful" or "vulgar", and wasn't punished. I was "disrespectful" in chat (just gonna put that in quotes because I still don't understand how I was), got kicked. Was "disrespectful" in TS, got kicked. 

That's a copy paste of my email I sent a while ago. I received the response from pelpelajex that my ban had already expired and that it wasn't worth appealing. However I'd appreciate if these bans/kicks didn't go towards any future punishments, and that they were removed.

Lavish was the mod (who was demodded as far as I know, just saying.) and sentinelADV was the admin. I can't seem to find the email but I'm sure someone can just do a quick search of your sent emails and find it (searching for "Shadowbladz" should do it)

replies.author: Shadowbladz
replies.body:
As far as I know the temporary ban still applies to my future punishments? ie. another punishment for vulgarity would be a perma. Seeing as how I believe all 3 of those punishments were bullshit (I'm only appealing the ban though) I don't think I'd be fair to be perma'd.

Sorry if I should've titled it something else

Since i wasn't there during this punishment it's hard to tell if it's really false or not. So i will not be appealing this infraction. I can't appeal based off your word that it's false

If you are worried about your next infraction being a Perma-Ban you should try your hardest not to break any of our rules. 

Regards,

Avicus Senior Moderator.
